task.pr_title: Add option to relax SNI validation

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description: It seems surprising that `ServerNameMustContainOneHostName` doesn't appear in the new version anymore.

evidence.attached_diff_hunk:
